artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan to add a shellcheck lint gate to the agent-system source store and clear all 196 current findings across 82 files before the gate is wired, so it lands green.

memory_candidates.content: When one task both introduces a lint/gate AND fixes the findings that gate will catch, the gate script must land in the FIRST phase and the fix passes must depend on it -- not because the fixes need the script to run, but because the repository's plan-format contract requires every phase's verification criteria to invoke the sanctioned entry point for a tool rather than the bare binary, and to check its exit status. The gate script IS that entry point, so it is the verifier for every later phase. The gate's WIRING (into the numbered gate set / CI) still goes last, so the gate is never enforceable while the tree is red. The resulting shape is: author the lint -> author its fixture test -> fix passes serialized by file territory -> wire the gate + redeploy + full gate set. A plan that puts the lint and the first fix pass in the same wave looks more parallel but leaves the fix phases with no sanctioned verifier.
